abstract: Tumor marker identification in testicular cancer has contributed to early detection and monitoring of non-seminomatous disease. A placental alkaline phosphatase-like (PLAP-like) enzyme derived from seminomas has recently been focused upon as a possible marker for this disease. The biochemistry of the PLAP-like enzyme is reviewed, as well as its occurrence in tissue and sera from healthy persons and patients with testicular cancer.
abstract_ja: 腫瘍マーカーの同定は、精巣がんの早期発見と非セミノーマ性疾患の経過観察に寄与してきた。セミノーマ由来の胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ様(PLAP様)酵素は、この疾患の腫瘍マーカーとして近年注目されている。本稿では、PLAP様酵素の生化学を概説するとともに、健常者および精巣がん患者の組織および血清中での出現について述べる。
